description: Date Range Picker - Smarter Date Filtering for Power BI Date Range Picker is a calendar-based filter visual for Power BI that replaces the clunky native date slicer with a clean, intuitive UI your report users will actually enjoy. Pick a start date, pick an end date, hit Apply - every connected visual updates instantly. No sliders, no manual typing, no confusion. Why Date Range Picker? Power BI's built-in date slicer offers a slider bar - functional, but not user-friendly for non-technical audiences. Date Range Picker gives your stakeholders a familiar calendar interface, one-click quick periods, and an Apply/Cancel workflow that prevents accidental filter changes. Key Features Interactive Calendar UI: Click any start and end date on a visual calendar grid. Hover highlights, range shading, and today's date marker make selection effortless. 15 Quick Period Presets: Last 7 Days, Last 30 Days, This Month, Last Month, This Quarter, Last Quarter, This Year, Last Year, YTD, MTD, QTD, Last 3/6/12 Months - one click, filter applied. Collapsed & Expanded States: Compact bar on your dashboard. Expands to full calendar on click. Returns to compact after Apply. Manual Date Input: Type dates in MM/DD/YYYY format with built-in validation. Invalid entries flagged with a red border.
